failure.name: TypeError
failure.cause: The probe discarded the PDFDocumentLoadingTask and called destroy() on PDFDocumentProxy. In locked pdfjs-dist 6.3.289, destroy() is exposed by the loading task while the document proxy exposes cleanup().
failure.effect: The finally block threw after text extraction and before coordinates were serialized or the parser was invoked. No parser or financial result exists for this attempt.
